scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && bun install && bun scripts/update-bun-hash.mjs && bun run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: for p in packages/*/tsconfig.json examples/*/tsconfig.json; do echo "-- $p"; tsc --noEmit -p "$p" || exit 1; done
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd examples/basic build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/env build && bun run --cwd packages/adapter-vercel build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/auth build && bun run --cwd packages/hooks build && bun run --cwd packages/mcp build
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun --cwd examples/basic run dev
scripts.vercel-build: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd examples/basic vercel-build && rm -rf .vercel/output && mkdir -p .vercel && cp -R examples/basic/.vercel/output .vercel/output && rm -rf examples/basic/.vercel
scripts.postinstall: bun run build:packages && cd packages/cli && bun link --force && echo '[x] "x" CLI linked globally. Make sure ~/.bun/bin is in your PATH.' || echo '[x] Could not link globally. Use "bun run dev" in the example instead.'
